lines: Another glacier dissolved overnight. Look at the horizon... red soot falling like ash.
The Pyre Empire's steam engines are boiling our sacred hunting waters and chaining our tide-shapers.

tide_act1_03.stage_direction: Pyre Patrol Boat animates into dock
lines: By order of the Ember Warlord! This fjord belongs to the Iron Forge Guild. Surrender your tide-shapers!
You won't take another person from this village!
